item.text: I’m using the poteto-mode Feature workflow. I’ll trace the existing session commands and lineage data, then add the tree view and verify it through the CLI.

The data model already records parent session IDs and distinguishes branches from compression continuations. I’m checking those existing rules before choosing the tree shape.

Worklist: 1. Trace the CLI and lineage model. 2. Compare designs. 3. Set the implementation checkpoint. 4. Implement. 5. Verify the CLI. 6. Check documentation impact. 7. Review delivery.
